blocks.text: Screenwriters Cédric Kahn, Kahina Le Querrec
With Zoé Monpart, Malou Khebizi, Kenji Peyran

When 17-year-old Lucia is brought to the ward, she already knows everyone. It’s not her first time there, but the arrival of a mysterious young man threatens the fragile equilibrium of the unit. Combining documentary-style observations with a lyrical third act, alongside moving performances from its mostly non-professional young cast, A Place to Heal pays homage to those precious places that offer space to heal.
Contains themes of domestic violence or abuse, self harm, and suicide.

blocks.text: Barry Keoghan plays a social worker trying to make up for the past in this heartfelt coming-of-age Irish drama about second chances.
In this striking British feature debut, a young man living in supported accommodation tries to juggle his musical aspirations and mental health issues.
The debut of French New Wave filmmaker Paula Delsol fell into oblivion, but her essential contribution to cinema is now ready for rediscovery.
